schedules.name: Daily Structure Review
schedules.description: Taxonomy analyzes codebase organization and creates suggestion for human review

tasks.description:
[CONTEXT] Review codebase organization and structure. Focus on architecture, not bugs.

[FILES] studio/**/*.py, server_modules/**/*.py, backends/**/*.py

[CONSTRAINTS] ONE suggestion only. Use create_suggestion with category 'codebase'.

[WHAT] Audit for:

**ORGANIZATION:**
- Files >500 lines that should be split
- Modules in wrong directories
- Inconsistent naming (mixedCase vs snake_case)
- Dead/unused files
- Missing __init__.py or improper exports

**ARCHITECTURE:**
- God classes (>10 public methods)
- Circular imports between modules
- Business logic in wrong layer (routes doing DB work, etc.)
- Tight coupling between unrelated modules

**SKIP:**
- Code bugs (QA handles those)
- Style preferences
- Missing docstrings
- Type hints

Output: create_suggestion titled 'Structure Review - {date}' listing 3-5 issues with file paths and recommended reorganization.

schedules.name: Daily Bug Audit
schedules.description: QA analyzes code for bugs and creates suggestion for human review

tasks.description:
[CONTEXT] Find real bugs that would fail code review. Trace execution flow before reporting.

[FILES] studio/**/*.py, server_modules/**/*.py, backends/**/*.py

[CONSTRAINTS] ONE suggestion only. Only report bugs you can prove. Use create_suggestion with category 'codebase'.

[WHAT] Audit for:

**EXECUTION BUGS:**
- Unhandled exceptions that crash (trace the call path)
- Resource leaks (files, connections not closed)
- Logic errors (off-by-one, wrong operator, inverted condition)
- Null/None access without guards

**CONCURRENCY (trace carefully):**
- Race conditions in ASYNC code (not sync)
- Thread-unsafe shared state in ThreadPoolExecutor callbacks
- Missing locks on mutable globals accessed from multiple threads

**ERROR HANDLING:**
- External calls (API, file I/O) without try/except
- Swallowed exceptions (except: pass)
- Error states that leave system inconsistent

**BEFORE REPORTING:**
- Trace the actual execution flow
- Confirm the bug can actually happen
- Identify sync vs async code

**SKIP:**
- Structure issues (Taxonomy handles those)
- Style preferences
- Theoretical issues that can't happen

Output: create_suggestion titled 'Bug Audit - {date}' listing 3-5 confirmed bugs with file:line, execution trace, and fix.
